rung_purposes.purpose: Set motor overload alarm M191 when motor overload contact X13 opens.
Reset latched fault M190 when fault reset pushbutton PB-0002 (X1) is pressed.
Activate common fault M199 if latched fault M190, overload M191, or E-stop X0 is tripped.
Energize conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) in auto mode SS-0003 (X2) when no common fault exists.
Update pallet in position flag M100 from pallet stop photo-eye PE-1001 (X10).
Latch stopper release solenoid XY-1004 on release request RQ-1005 rising edge.
Start 2.0 s stopper release timer T11 while stopper release solenoid XY-1004 is active.
Reset stopper release solenoid XY-1004 (Y11) when timer T11 completes.
